propositions: Close workflow lacks direct gated-phase timings, conflating pre-verifier work into an inferred residual that obscures eight-minute silent intervals and cohort gaps

Instrumentation must use only time.monotonic_ns(), integer arithmetic, and dictionary assignments on the existing call path without adding I/O, subprocess, network, tracker event, model call, lock, retry, or tracing backend
Ten direct millisecond timing fields must be recorded on the call path from close_ticket through completion-verifier return, then merged into COMPLETION_VERDICT.metrics before sidecar emission
Performance constraint requires measured bookkeeping to cost less than 50 microseconds per close operation, verified via standard-library CPU-time differential benchmark
Duration probe must consume direct timing fields when present and mark older records without them as legacy_uninstrumented without causal residual attribution
